On Sat, Nov 23, 2013 at 2:25 AM, Sivaji Doguparthi <groups...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi All,

I have a quick question about the RHadoop streaming..
I know Hadoop streaming and I know RHadoop. RHadoop streaming? New to me.
Lets say I am reading a Hdfs file using from.dfs function and I can read the same using mapreduce function as well.
from.dfs will read into memory, mapreduce function will process disk to disk. They are not interchangeable.
the question is, in both cases hadoop streaming file uses?

If I understand the question, yes in both cases. From.dfs uses hadoop streaming to perform a conversion from sequence file to naked typedbytes.  I hope users don't need to worry about these gory details.


Antonio
 

Regards,
Sivaji
